action.command:
docker run --rm quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 sh -c '
cd /tmp
for j in /opt/keycloak/lib/main/quarkus/lib/*.jar; do
  unzip -l "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "messages.properties" && echo "JAR: $j"
done | head -3
' 2>&1 | tail -5
